text:
Introduction
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes ... 
 etc
Ensure that the 
 earthing switch must be disconnected and properly grounded on both sides using 
 portable grounds.
Ensure that the 
 earthing switch must be disconnected and properly grounded on both sides using 
 portable grounds.
Circuit breaker must be isolated completely and 
 grounded on both sides.
Isolate the DC voltage
Change remote/local control switch to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Air blower, gas 
 detector, buzzer, screw driver,
Complete set of common keys
Works to be Carried Out
Visually inspect all 
 external components of the disconnect switch.
Check SF6 gas leakage using SF6 detector.
Clean the mechanism 
 cabinet using air blower.
Check SF6 pressure 
 (4 bar normal).
Check the enclosure 
 earth cable to ensure it is properly fastened.
Retighten all cable 
 terminals inside and outside cabinet.
Check the heater, 
 door gasket, clean gear box, grease thin layer of gear box if required.
Record no. of operations of disconnect switch.
